restrained-satire.voice_reason: X, like ref.md, lets judgment fall out of flat external detail and gesture (the equally green buttons, the evenly drawn zero, the thumb rubbing, the thickened attendance book) with no narrator commentary, while Z explains its own irony through Zhou's interior quips and closes on an aphoristic simile.
restrained-satire.notes: V, W and Z are near-copies of one text; W differs mainly by dropping the closing simile '安静得像一个设计得很成功的产品', which is why it ranks above V and Z. V and Z are nearly indistinguishable (Z only omits '屏幕还有一项设计' and '更'). Y invents the letter's content (an eviction for a '文明岗亭') and has the director suggest '选已了解'; both are allowed fiction texture since Zhou still makes the choice himself before leaving work and the outcome is unchanged, but the director's prompt slightly weakens Zhou's own agency. X is the closest in voice but drops to last overall because it moves the substitution from 下班前 to a scene in front of the old man.
